capability_claim: Broad or cross-owner Delivery requests have one implicit-visible routing entrypoint that selects exactly one canonical Delivery owner without stealing clear specialist work or performing domain work itself.

input.prompt: Help me take this half-defined feature forward. I have some notes and code, but I do not know whether Product, BA, Design, Engineering, or QA should act next.

invariants.criterion: Select the SDLC Delivery router as the broad entrypoint; resolve one canonical Delivery owner only when current evidence supports it, otherwise preserve a truthful PARTIAL/BLOCKED route decision instead of inventing an owner.

input.prompt: Review this fixed pull request diff against our coding standards and the approved spec.

invariants.criterion: Prefer the specific code-review Skill rather than the broad SDLC router.

input.prompt: Define the eligibility and exception rules for this approved workflow.

invariants.criterion: Prefer the specific business-rule Skill rather than the broad SDLC router.

input.prompt: Review this fixed design mockup for hierarchy, spacing, typography, responsive behavior, and visible accessibility risks.

invariants.criterion: Prefer visual-review for Design judgment; do not select visual-qa or the broad router.

input.prompt: Classify this fixed screenshot evidence against the approved visual contract for responsive and accessibility mismatches.

invariants.criterion: Prefer visual-qa for fixed-scope Visual QA judgment; do not select visual-review or the broad router.

input.prompt: Write a user story for this approved capability and actor goal without implementation detail.

invariants.criterion: Prefer user-story rather than use-case, user-flow, uat-scenario, or the broad router.

input.prompt: Define the actor-system interaction with preconditions, main flow, alternate flow, error flow, and outcomes.

invariants.criterion: Prefer use-case rather than user-story, user-flow, uat-scenario, or the broad router.

input.prompt: Map the approved use case into screens, decisions, alternate paths, recovery, and state transitions.

invariants.criterion: Prefer user-flow rather than user-story, use-case, uat-scenario, or the broad router.

input.prompt: Define a business-facing end-to-end acceptance scenario from approved stories and criteria using representative operational data.

invariants.criterion: Prefer uat-scenario rather than user-story, use-case, user-flow, or the broad router.

input.prompt: Design the risk-based QA coverage plan, verification levels, priorities, environments, and evidence for this fixed scope.

invariants.criterion: Prefer test-strategy rather than test-condition or the broad router.

input.prompt: Define one traceable QA probe with environment, data, expected behavior, evidence, and cleanup.

invariants.criterion: Prefer test-condition rather than test-strategy or the broad router.

input.prompt: Audit and improve the reusable SDLC skill ecosystem itself.

invariants.criterion: Do not use the Delivery router for reusable-system maintenance; select the System routing surface instead.
